verdict.rationale: First-party docs show configurable retention for conversation transcripts and audio recordings, with a 2-year default that can be modified. That covers the data-retention half of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses per-call recording on/off controls or consent and disclosure mechanisms such as recording announcements or consent capture. Missing for 10: per-call recording toggle, consent/disclosure prompt or capture features, documented retention options beyond the default, independent or hands-on corroboration.
